issues.description: The problem statement's UML and description declare StockIngredient.price as an int and its constructor as StockIngredient(String, int, int), but the template implementation declares price as a double and the constructor takes a double. The solution uses int. This type mismatch across artifacts can confuse students about which type to use and will cause compilation/type issues when they implement methods (e.g., calculateTotalPrice expects integer prices per the spec/UML).
issues.suggestedFix: Align the StockIngredient price type across artifacts. Recommended: change the template StockIngredient.price and its constructor/getPrice to use int (matching the UML/problem statement and the solution). Alternatively, update the problem statement/UML to use double if that was intended.
